conflict_resolution_rules.description: When operator corrections conflict with any other source, operator corrections are canonical.
When code conflicts with documentation, code is current truth. Documentation becomes 'future intent' or 'historical'.
When replit.md conflicts with prior phase artifacts, replit.md wins because it was written closer to the code and cross-validates better.
PRD v2.0 supersedes PRD v1.0 for all product direction questions.
Phase 14.6B findings supersede 14.5A, which supersedes 14.5, which supersedes 14.4.
